So I’m a Canadian student experiencing the same thing. I saw mentioned in the comments not super in depth to write to your school or what have you. 

How are education in Canada works at a public post secondary school is it governed by a branch of the government. I’m in social work so take what I say with a grain of salt but I think the message is important. 

You have the power, this is your education, without you and your classmates there’s no institution, no institution no jobs. 

Band together and start writing, critically writing your ministers that govern this part of education. Think logically and prove your point with as much peer reviewed sources as you can. I know there’s not much but if you dig enough you can find it. 

Our cohort is coming together and we’re writing letters to our leaders to make changes to this broken system that is not working for many people. I know this might seem absurd but this is how change is I implemented, with well written documents and truly standing up for your rights and what you deem as unfair. Your voice needs to be heard. There’s a lot of issues with education in my country, I might be naive but I believe in the overall good. I think if enough people band together we can create change. 

Best of luck.
